proposed.text: A 5-storey office building has a floor plate of 195 sq.m with 18 occupants per floor. No sprinkler system is planned. Under PD 1096 Rule XII, Sec. 1212, is a fire-extinguishing system required?

options.text: Yes, because it is a 5-storey building, which typically necessitates additional fire safety measures.
Yes, because 195 sq.m is approximately equal to 200 sq.m, which is a common threshold for fire safety requirements.
No, because both the area (195 sq.m < 200 sq.m) and occupant load (18 ≤ 20) thresholds are below their respective trigger values
No, but one is required by RA 9514 regardless of floor area and occupant load, ensuring compliance with broader fire safety regulations.
